R1.statement: The task requires detaching the three interior-angle pieces from one triangle and arranging those same pieces along a straight line to form 180 degrees.

questions.question: Does the video visibly move the three angle pieces from one triangle into a straight angle while preserving their sizes and correspondence?

targets.criterion: The three detached pieces visibly correspond to the three interior angles of the same original triangle.
The same pieces are visibly rearranged with their angle sizes preserved to form a straight angle, rather than only displaying the final angle-sum statement.
